parts.text: Using this exact product bottle as the main subject, generate a new lifestyle photograph where this supplement bottle is sitting on a clean white marble countertop next to prescription statin medication bottles (like Lipitor, Crestor). Warm natural morning light from the side. Shallow depth of field. The supplement bottle from the reference image should be the hero subject in sharp focus. The statin bottles are slightly behind and to the side, softly blurred. Clean minimal bright background. High-end commercial product photography style. Keep the exact same bottle design, label, and branding from the reference.
